questions.subject: DISCRETE_MATHEMATICS_II
questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.
questions.stem: Sum of r^i from i=0 to 6 when r=3? (case 4)
questions.explanation: The geometric series sum from i=0 to 6 of 3^i is (3^7-1)/(3-1)=1093. Using 3^6 alone would count only the final term.
questions.hint: Use the finite geometric series formula.

questions.explanation: By the binomial theorem the coefficient of x^3 in (1+x)^8 is C(8,3)=56. Permutations would apply if order mattered, which it does not here.
